Title: Coffee Break (Boots On, Heart Open)
(Verse 1) Sun’s comin’ up over Newcastle way, P.O. Box waitin’ on another pay day. Lyrics in my notebook, coffee in my cup, Dreamin’ ‘bout the stage but stayin’ way back up. From “Orange Jeans” to “Her Wings” in the air, I’m writin’ through the storm when the world’s unfair. Mum life, uni books, and a melody call, Pour another black, let the good times roll.
(Chorus) It’s a coffee break, boots on the ground, kobcountrymusic spinnin’ ‘round and ‘round. Remix that feelin’, let the guitar ring, From Cardiff NSW to wherever you sing. Tired hands on the keys, but the heart’s still strong, One more verse, one more song. Yeah, it’s a coffee break — strong and sweet, Keep on writin’ till the dream’s complete!
(Verse 2) “Boots and Coffee Break” bumpin’ on the stream, Low plays but high hopes in the country scene. Classic country sound with a little bit of fear, No big stages yet, no spotlight glow. But merch on Bonfire and lyrics on the go. Vision board up, tarot cards in hand, Faith and hope keep me dancin’ in the sand.
(Chorus) It’s a coffee break, boots on the ground, kobcountrymusic spinnin’ ‘round and ‘round. Remix that feelin’, let the guitar ring, From the farm gal heart to the songs we bring. Mornin’ sex dreams? Nah, just mornin’ brew, Late-night texts can wait — this coffee’s for you. Yeah, it’s a coffee break — strong and sweet, Keep on writin’ till the dream’s complete!
(Bridge – slower, heartfelt) God bless the grind and the “tired as” nights, Player texts and green bubbles outta sight. I’m buildin’ something real from the words I write, One song at a time under these southern lights.
(Final Chorus – upbeat fade) It’s a coffee break, boots stompin’ loud, kobcountrymusic makin’ her mama proud. From “Saturday Sorrows” to the light of day, Pour it up strong — here’s to findin’ our way! Coffee break… boots and all… Keep the music playin’, answer the call.
(Outro) Lol… Ok… All good x But the coffee’s hot and the song ain’t done yet.

# **I Am the Golden Retriever**

I'm the golden retriever who greets the morning like it's the best day ever.

My tail never really stops wagging.  SUNSHINE follows me everywhere, even after the rain.

I love with my whole heart. When someone matters to me, I stay loyal through sunshine, storms, and every ordinary day in between.

I bring people together. I chase dreams with joyful energy, collect memories instead of trophies, and find magic in the little moments: a warm coffee, a favourite song, a laugh that arrives out of nowhere.

My heart is gentle, but don't mistake kindness for weakness. When the people I love need me, I stand beside them with quiet courage.

I forgive quickly.
I celebrate loudly.
I believe every new sunrise deserves another chance.

Music is my tennis ball. I chase melodies with excitement, carrying them back again and again until they become songs worth sharing.

My smile is contagious.
My spirit is bright.
My loyalty runs deep.

If life throws me a stick, I'll chase it.
If life throws me a challenge, I'll face it.
If life gives me love, I'll treasure it.

I'm a golden retriever at heart:
Loyal.
Playful.
Optimistic.
Affectionate.
Always ready for the next adventure.
Always believing there's something wonderful just around the corner.

When someone keeps saying “I can’t read this” in response to your messages, especially repeatedly, it can mean a few different things depending on tone, intention, and pattern. Let’s break it down:

⸻

💬 Possible Meanings Behind “I Can’t Read This”:

1. Genuine confusion or overwhelm
	•	Maybe your message was long, emotional, or detailed.
	•	They might feel mentally or emotionally overloaded and can’t process it.
	•	This isn’t narcissism — it could just be a need for simpler communication in the moment.

2. Avoidance or shutdown
	•	They may not want to deal with the content (especially if it holds them accountable).
	•	Saying “I can’t read this” becomes a way to escape responsibility or end the conversation without resolving anything.

3. Dismissive or manipulative tactic
	•	If it’s constant, and they never try to engage with what you’re saying, it can be a way to invalidate you.
	•	This can be a narcissistic trait — especially if they’re turning it back on you (“You’re too much,” “You’re crazy,” etc.) and never reflect on their part.

⸻

🚩 Narcissistic Red Flags:
	•	They say “I can’t read this” but expect you to read and respond to everything they say.
	•	They show no effort to try or ask you to explain, they just shut you down.
	•	They use this line to control when, how, or if you’re allowed to express yourself.

⸻

✅ What You Can Do:
	•	Clarify: “Can you tell me what part is hard to read or overwhelming?”
	•	Set boundaries: “It’s okay if you need a break, but please don’t dismiss me.”
	•	Protect your energy: If this is part of a larger pattern of emotional invalidation, it’s worth reflecting on whether this communication is respectful or harmful to you.

⸻
